 Order

02.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This is an application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Ramagiri P.S. Case No.50 of 2019 corresponding to G.R. Case No.01 of 2020 pending in the Court of learned Special Judge -cum- Additional Sessions Judge, Paralakhemundi for offences punishable under sections 342/376- AB/376(2)(n)/506 of Indian Penal Code read with section 66-A of I.T. Act & 6 of the POCSO Act.

entities.text: Court of learned Special Judge -cum- Additional Sessions Judge, Paralakhemundi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. S. S. Ray-2, learned counsel appearing for the informant submitted that the case is now posted to 16.07.2024 for argument.

Learned counsel for the petitioner, on the other hand, submitted that since the petitioner was not afforded any opportunity to adduce the defence evidence and after closure of the case from both sides, the learned trial Court fixed the date for argument, the petitioner challenged the order before Divya Mohan Beero @ vs State Of Odisha ....

entities.text: Divya Mohan Beero @ vs State Of Odisha
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Opp. Party on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98688147/
1
this Court and this Court in CRLREV No.185 of 2024, vide order dated 03.07.2024 has allowed the prayer made by the petitioner to adduce the defence evidence.

Be that as it may, since the case is at the stage of defence evidence and it is expected that the petitioner would produce his defence witness at an earliest and thereafter, the follow up action would be taken, at this stage, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
The BLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge Divya Mohan Beero @ vs State Of Odisha .... Opp.
